data.summary: Maintained, enhanced, and developed business-critical applications for PT Bali Towerindo Sentra, PT Bangun Kelola Swadaya (PTBKS), PT Paramitra Intimega (PTPIM), and PT Jelajah Data Semesta (PTJDS). Collaborated with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.
bullets: Developed and enhanced E-Submission platforms for vendor document management and automated approval workflows integrated with Oracle systems.
Maintained and optimized Intranet and MIS applications through bug fixing, query tuning, caching implementation, and feature enhancements.
Built and integrated APIs for internal and customer-facing applications, including router management and mobile platforms.
Developed Single Sign-On (SSO) solutions with Cloudflare integration, centralized logging, and role-based access management.

Strengthened application security by implementing VAPT recommendations, including secure HTTP headers, input validation, SQL injection prevention, and authentication improvements.
